scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Two1920-tet actual original-control contact references on matched-connectivity CAD/polyhedron geometry with all five dynamic states independently audited

egg-paired-polyhedron-level2-contact-v2.scope: Resolve matched original two-jaw controls on declared CAD or fixed-polyhedron egg geometry.
egg-paired-polyhedron-level2-contact-v2.limitations: Original actual finger geoms, physical held points/components, material/density, friction, actuation, timestep and force budgets are preserved. CAD and polyhedral models have their explicitly measured different represented volume/mass. Five states are a short diagnostic, not a complete application/history or converged contact reference. Every saved state still requires independent force/global-field auditing. Geometry, bulk, contact integration and regularization axes, models/feedback and verified accuracy/cost remain open.

egg-paired-polyhedron-level2-contact-v2-.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
egg-paired-polyhedron-level2-contact-v2-.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

summary.limitations: Material/density, actual fingers, physical initializer points/components, friction, dhat, jaw actuation and dt are fixed. Geometry and represented mass differ explicitly; this comparison does not isolate pure geometry stress error. All64 held closure residuals are producer records, not independent audits of every closure state. Five independently reconstructed dynamic states do not establish a full original history, a contact/geometry tail, remaining model/feedback accuracy or verified warmed cost. Finer live producers are excluded.

limitations: Two declared1920-tet geometry families,64 freshly solved held closure targets each and10 independently reconstructed original dynamic states. Raw peaks, full-volume bounds and contact diagnostics remain explicit. Fixed density causes different represented mass on CAD/polyhedral geometry. These short references do not establish geometry/contact convergence, complete application/history, models/feedback or verified accuracy/cost. Finer live runs are excluded. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
